item.title: Apocrypha
item.description:
Apocrypha is a high-level religious technology and system in Kittens Game that is crucial for converting accumulated Worship into a permanent prestige resource called Epiphany, which is retained across game resets.

1. Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisites: Apocrypha is a religious upgrade that requires reaching a total of 100,000 Worship to unlock.
  • Cost: Once unlocked, purchasing Apocrypha requires 5,000 Faith and 5,000 Gold.

2. Core Functionality: Converting Prestige Currency

Apocrypha unlocks the ability to “Adore the Galaxy”. This action converts all accumulated Worship into Epiphany (a hidden resource formerly known as the “Apocrypha bonus”).
item.content:encoded:
Apocrypha is a high-level religious technology and system in Kittens Game that is crucial for converting accumulated Worship into a permanent prestige resource called Epiphany, which is retained across game resets.

1. Unlocking and Cost

  • Prerequisites: Apocrypha is a religious upgrade that requires reaching a total of 100,000 Worship to unlock.
  • Cost: Once unlocked, purchasing Apocrypha requires 5,000 Faith and 5,000 Gold.

2. Core Functionality: Converting Prestige Currency

Apocrypha unlocks the ability to “Adore the Galaxy”. This action converts all accumulated Worship into Epiphany (a hidden resource formerly known as the “Apocrypha bonus”).

  • Epiphany Effect: Epiphany drives a bonus that makes future Praising (converting Faith to Worship) significantly stronger. This bonus is displayed on the “Praise the Sun!” button.
  • Reset Carry-over: Epiphany is a critical resource because it carries over upon game reset.
  • Worship Loss: Although Apocrypha allows Worship to convert into Epiphany (with a slight penalty) upon a hard game reset, players are advised that it is better to manually Adore the Galaxy before resetting to maximise the benefit. If you forget to manually convert, you won’t lose much of the Worship.

3. Relationship with Transcendence

Apocrypha is integral to the Transcendence system, which is essential for maximizing permanent gains:

  • Transcendence Requirement: Apocrypha is required to unlock Transcendence (which requires 125,000 Worship, 7,500 Faith, and 7,500 Gold).
  • Staging the Reset: To maximize the gain derived from Faith investment before a game reset, players must always execute Transcendence (spending Epiphany to increase Transcendence tiers) before performing Apocrypha (Adoring the Galaxy). This ensures that the Epiphany gain is maximized, as Transcendence tiers increase the conversion multiplier when Adoring the Galaxy.
  • Boosting Solar Revolution: The accumulation of a high Apocrypha bonus (Epiphany) is essential because it allows the player to quickly achieve a high Solar Revolution production bonus in subsequent runs. The Apocrypha bonus is often referred to as the “Adore percentage” when determining if performing Transcendence is worth the temporary sacrifice.

4. Strategic Importance

Apocrypha is a major step in Phase 3 of the game (Religious and Energy Transition Epoch), as it defines how players convert ephemeral religious production into permanent prestige capital.

  • Long-Term Farming: Strategically, you will want to get your Faith and Gold caps high enough to start ‘storing’ it with Apocrypha. In late-game runs, achieving high Apocrypha bonuses (over 3 million percent is needed for Transcendence Tier 15) is necessary to unlock high-tier religious abilities that boost late-game production, such as Blazar.
  • Iron Will Mode: In the resource-constrained Iron Will mode, getting the Apocrypha bonus high prior to entering the mode is suggested, as the resulting high Solar Revolution bonus (which uses Worship/Faith) is highly useful in Iron Will.

item.title: Basilica
item.description:
The Basilica is a late-game upgrade available for the Temple building, focusing on significantly increasing your cultural resources.

Here are the details regarding the Basilica upgrade:

Unlocking and Cost

Detail Specification
Building Type Upgrade for Temple.
Prerequisite Requires 10,000 Worship.
Cost 1250 Faith and 750 Gold.
Price Ratio 2.5.

Effects on Temples

The Basilica primarily boosts the cultural output and storage capacity provided by your Temples:

  • Culture Production: Increases Temple Culture per Tick by $+0.2$.
  • Culture Storage: Increases Temple Max Culture by $+125$.

Transcendence Scaling

The Basilica is one of the religious abilities that can be purchased multiple times using Transcendence tiers, which are acquired by spending Epiphany.

item.title: Epiphany
item.description:
Epiphany is a core prestige resource in Kittens Game, converted from your accumulated Worship and retained across game resets to accelerate progress in subsequent runs.

Function and Conversion

  1. Conversion: Epiphany is converted from Worship by performing the action “Adore the Galaxy”. This ability is unlocked after purchasing the Apocrypha religious upgrade, which requires 100,000 Worship, 5,000 Faith, and 5,000 Gold.
  2. Primary Effect: Epiphany drives a bonus that makes future Praising (converting Faith to Worship) significantly stronger. This bonus helps players quickly build up the Solar Revolution production bonus after a reset.
  3. Persistence: Epiphany is a special resource that carries over upon game reset, providing permanent acceleration for future runs. If you do not manually convert your Worship to Epiphany before resetting, the Worship will convert automatically with a slight penalty.

Role in Transcendence

Epiphany is the currency used to gain Transcendence Tiers (TT), which are permanent religious upgrades.

Role in Transcendence

Epiphany is the currency used to gain Transcendence Tiers (TT), which are permanent religious upgrades.

  • Spending Epiphany: The Transcend mechanism allows you to spend Epiphany to increase your Transcendence Tier.
  • Multiplier: Increasing the Transcendence Tier, in turn, increases the conversion multiplier when performing “Adore the Galaxy”.
  • Strategic Reset: To maximise the Epiphany bonus before resetting the game, the player should always execute Transcendence BEFORE Apocrypha (Adoring the Galaxy).

For reference, the minimum Epiphany needed to reach Transcendence Tier 15 is approximately 3.04 million per cent. A high Epiphany bonus is necessary to rapidly reach high Solar Revolution bonuses and is particularly useful in challenge modes like Iron Will.

Historical Naming

For historic reasons, Epiphany may sometimes be referred to in the sources or gameplay community as Apocrypha bonus or Adoration.

item.title: Praise the sun
item.description:
“Praise the sun!” is a core action within the Religion tab of Kittens Game, defining the process of converting the special resource Faith into the resource Worship.

Function and Resource Conversion

The action is available once you have any amount of accumulated Faith. When you select the “Praise the sun!” option:

  • It converts all accumulated Faith into Worship.
  • The system operates under the Order of the Sun, which is unlocked once you build a Temple (unlocked after researching Philosophy and subsequently Theology).

Worship is the name given to what was previously referred to as “praised faith”.
item.content:encoded:
“Praise the sun!” is a core action within the Religion tab of Kittens Game, defining the process of converting the special resource Faith into the resource Worship.

Function and Resource Conversion

The action is available once you have any amount of accumulated Faith. When you select the “Praise the sun!” option:

  • It converts all accumulated Faith into Worship.
  • The system operates under the Order of the Sun, which is unlocked once you build a Temple (unlocked after researching Philosophy and subsequently Theology).

Worship is the name given to what was previously referred to as “praised faith”.

Uses of Worship

The primary purpose of performing “Praise the sun!” is to accumulate Worship, which serves two main goals:

  1. Unlocking Religious Upgrades: Various religious upgrades can be purchased using Faith, but only once sufficient Worship has been accumulated to unlock them. Examples include:

    • Solar Chant (requires 150 Worship).
    • Scholasticism (requires 300 Worship).
    • Sun Altar and Stained Glass (require 750 Worship).

  2. Solar Revolution Production Bonus: Once you reach 1000 Worship, you can purchase the Solar Revolution upgrade (costs 750 Faith and 500 Gold). This grants a global production bonus based on the amount of accumulated Worship. This bonus is initially capped at 1000%, with diminishing returns starting at 750%.

Long-Term Progression (Epiphany)

Later in the game, the effectiveness of praising the sun is tied to the Epiphany mechanic:

  • After researching Apocrypha (which requires 100K Worship and 5000 Faith/5000 Gold), you unlock the ability to “Adore the galaxy”.
  • Adoring the galaxy sacrifices all accumulated Worship and converts it into the hidden resource Epiphany (formerly called the “Apocrypha bonus”).
  • Epiphany drives a bonus that makes future Praising (i.e., converting Faith into Worship) stronger. This bonus is displayed on the “Praise” button.
  • A major strategy in later runs involves pushing the Apocrypha/Epiphany bonus high so that after a reset, you can quickly achieve the maximum Solar Revolution production bonus by converting stored Faith into Worship via Praising the Sun.

item.title: Stained Glass

Requirements and Cost

Stained Glass becomes available for purchase relatively early in the religious progression:

Context

Stained Glass is unlocked at the same Worship threshold (750) as the Sun Altar upgrade. Both of these upgrades enhance the functionality of Temples.

Since Temples are one of the buildings that generate Culture (along with Amphitheatres and Chapels), Stained Glass helps advance your culture production. Culture is a vital special resource used to craft Manuscripts from Parchment, which are required for researching advanced technologies like Theology and Astronomy.

item.title: Sun Altar
item.description:
The Sun Altar is a crucial religious upgrade available in Kittens Game, found under the Order of the Sun within the Religion tab.

Here is a breakdown of its effects, costs, and requirements:

Function and Effects

The Sun Altar provides dual benefits by enhancing both resource capacity (Faith) and kitten morale (Happiness):

  1. Faith Storage Increase: The upgrade increases Temple maximum faith storage by +50.
    • This bonus stacks, as each additional level of Sun Altar purchased using Transcendence increases this storage bonus by an additional +50.
  2. Happiness Contribution: The Sun Altar contributes to your civilization’s overall Happiness by increasing the happiness provided by Temples by +0.5%.
    • This happiness bonus also scales with Transcendence, increasing by an additional +0.1% for each additional level purchased.

The sources also mention that the Sun Altar contributes to overall Happiness, highlighting that Religious upgrades do affect things outside the Religion tab.

item.title: Golden Spire
item.description:
Golden Spire is a religious upgrade within the Order of the Sun that significantly expands your colony’s capacity to store faith by enhancing the effectiveness of your Temples.

Acquisition and Costs

  • Unlocking: The upgrade becomes available in the Religion tab once you have accumulated at least 500 Worship (formerly known as “praised faith”).
  • Cost: The initial purchase requires 350 Faith and 150 Gold.
  • Price Scaling: It follows a price ratio of 2.5, meaning that if you unlock the ability to buy multiple levels, each subsequent tier will be significantly more expensive.

Effects and Multipliers

  • Base Bonus: Upon the first purchase, Golden Spire provides a +50% bonus to the maximum faith provided by your Temples.
  • Application: Crucially, this 50% multiplier is applied after other effects, making it a powerful “final” multiplier for your faith cap.
  • Transcendence Synergy: Once you have unlocked Transcendence, Golden Spire becomes a tiered upgrade. Each additional level purchased increases the Temple storage bonus by an additional +10%.

Strategic Importance

As your religious progression moves toward the prestige transition, the Golden Spire is essential for overcoming storage bottlenecks. Late-game milestones require increasingly large faith caps; for example, unlocking Transcendence itself requires a 125k faith cap. By boosting the storage potential of every Temple you own, the Golden Spire allows you to reach these high thresholds without needing to build an excessive number of physical structures.

Effects and Function

The primary function of Scholasticism is to integrate your religious structures into your scientific development:

  • Science Contribution: Scholasticism allows Temples to contribute to Science.
  • Maximum Science Bonus: Specifically, it grants Temples an effect of +500 maximum science. This helps prevent the Science resource cap from becoming a bottleneck when researching advanced technologies.
  • Scaling: The maximum science bonus provided by Temples is further increased by +100 for each additional level of Scholasticism purchased using Transcendence.

The ability to increase your maximum science cap is highly beneficial, as achieving high science limits (like the 125K needed for Concrete Huts) often requires numerous Science buildings such as Libraries, Academies, and Observatories. Scholasticism provides a direct boost to this vital resource capacity through existing Temple infrastructure.

item.title: Solar Chant
item.description:
Solar Chant is an essential religious upgrade available in the Kittens Game under the Order of the Sun. It specifically targets and enhances your civilization’s ability to generate the special resource, Faith.

Here is a detailed explanation of Solar Chant, its prerequisites, and its strategic function:

Function and Effect

The primary purpose of Solar Chant is to increase your production of Faith.

  • Base Effect: Solar Chant improves your base faith generation rate by 10%.
  • Scaling: As you progress into the mid-to-late game, you can purchase additional levels of Solar Chant using Transcendence. Each additional level purchased increases this bonus by an additional +10%.

Cost and Prerequisites

Solar Chant is one of the early-game religious upgrades you should aim for to boost your Faith economy.

Function and Effect

  • Scaling: As you progress into the mid-to-late game, you can purchase additional levels of Solar Chant using Transcendence. Each additional level purchased increases this bonus by an additional +10%.

Cost and Prerequisites

Solar Chant is one of the early-game religious upgrades you should aim for to boost your Faith economy.

  • Prerequisite: The upgrade only becomes available for purchase once you have accumulated 150 Worship.
  • Cost: The initial cost of the upgrade is 100 Faith.

Strategic Importance

Purchasing multiple levels of Solar Chant is a critical late-game strategy, especially as Faith production is generally affected by production boosts like Paragon but remains inherently slow.

By boosting your Faith income via multiple levels of Solar Chant (achieved through Transcendence), you can more effectively engage in the “Praise the sun!” mechanic, which converts accumulated Faith into Worship.

This strategy is vital because maximizing faith generation allows you to quickly restore your Solar Revolution bonus (a global production boost derived from Worship) after you have “reset” your faith pool using the Adore the galaxy option (unlocked via Apocrypha). In the late game, many kittens are typically assigned as [Priests] ( /job/priest/) to maximize Faith generation, making the boost provided by Solar Chant highly impactful.

item.title: Solar Revolution
item.description:
Solar Revolution is a high-impact religious upgrade within the Order of the Sun that provides a permanent global production bonus to nearly all resources in the game. To unlock this multiplier, you must first research Theology, accumulate at least 1,000 Worship, and spend 750 Faith and 500 Gold.

Mechanism and Scaling

  • Calculation: The bonus is calculated based on your total accumulated worship using the formula: $(sqrt(1+8 * worship / 1000)-1)/2$.
  • Initial Impact: While it may only provide a modest boost of 4–5% shortly after it is unlocked, it eventually becomes a primary driver of colony growth.
  • Production Speed: At higher levels, it can increase production rates to 50x normal speeds, making expensive buildings and housing far more affordable.
  • Science Boost: In addition to physical resources, overall science production is directly enhanced by the Solar Revolution multiplier.

Caps and Diminishing Returns

The production bonus is subject to diminishing returns starting at 750% and is initially hard-capped at 1,000%. However, this cap can be extended through advanced late-game mechanics:
item.content:encoded:
Solar Revolution is a high-impact religious upgrade within the Order of the Sun that provides a permanent global production bonus to nearly all resources in the game. To unlock this multiplier, you must first research Theology, accumulate at least 1,000 Worship, and spend 750 Faith and 500 Gold.

Mechanism and Scaling

  • Calculation: The bonus is calculated based on your total accumulated worship using the formula: $(sqrt(1+8 * worship / 1000)-1)/2$.
  • Initial Impact: While it may only provide a modest boost of 4–5% shortly after it is unlocked, it eventually becomes a primary driver of colony growth.
  • Production Speed: At higher levels, it can increase production rates to 50x normal speeds, making expensive buildings and housing far more affordable.
  • Science Boost: In addition to physical resources, overall science production is directly enhanced by the Solar Revolution multiplier.

Caps and Diminishing Returns

The production bonus is subject to diminishing returns starting at 750% and is initially hard-capped at 1,000%. However, this cap can be extended through advanced late-game mechanics:

  • Black Obelisks: These cryptotheology buildings improve the Solar Revolution bonus cap by +5% per transcendence tier.
  • Atheism Challenge: While this challenge disables the Solar Revolution bonus entirely during the run, completing it provides a permanent reward where the cap increases by 100 percentage points for every Transcendence tier you possess.
  • Effectiveness Reward: Successive completions of the Atheism challenge also increase the effectiveness of the bonus by 10% per run, multiplicative with Black Obelisks.

Strategic Utility and Management

  • Unicorn Era: Solar Revolution is essential for late-game progression because it is one of the only multipliers that affects unicorn production.
  • Managing Sacrifices: Because the bonus is so powerful, it is generally considered suboptimal to sacrifice faith for Apocrypha or Transcendence mid-run if it will significantly lower your current production bonus. Strategic advice suggests only sacrificing once you can quickly rebuild the bonus to the 750–1,000% range.
  • Apocrypha Synergy: A high Apocrypha (epiphany) bonus is vital because it allows you to praise the sun more effectively, enabling you to regain your maximum Solar Revolution multiplier in seconds after a reset.
  • Environmental Factors: You should be aware that high levels of pollution can harm resource production by negatively affecting your Solar Revolution bonus.
  • Iron Will: In specialized Iron Will runs, Solar Revolution is a critical tool for overcoming the lack of kitten-based labor; players are encouraged to build a high Apocrypha bonus in previous runs to facilitate rapid growth in this mode.

Where to See Its Value

You can check your active Solar Revolution bonus in two places in the game interface:

  1. On the Religion Tab (Direct Value)
  • Open the Religion tab.
  • Look directly beneath the Order of the Sun section header (near the “Praise the Sun!” button).
  • You will see a readout displaying: +XXX.XX% bonus
  1. Resource Hover Tooltips (Applied Breakdown)
  • In the left-hand resource pane, hover your cursor over the +per sec production rate of any standard resource (such as Catnip, Minerals, or Iron).
  • A breakdown tooltip will appear detailing all active modifiers. Look for the Solar Revolution line item, which shows the exact percentage boost it contributes to that specific resource’s net output.

item.title: Solarchant
item.description:
Solar Chant is a fundamental religious upgrade found within the Order of the Sun section of the Religion tab. It serves as a primary driver for scaling your colony’s religious economy by directly increasing the rate at which Faith is generated.

Cost and Requirements

  • Initial Cost: 100 Faith.
  • Prerequisite: You must have accumulated at least 150 Worship (formerly known as “praised faith”) to unlock the option to purchase it.
  • Price Ratio: It has a price ratio of 2.5, meaning that if you unlock the ability to purchase multiple levels, each subsequent tier will cost 2.5 times more than the last.

Core Effects and Stacking

  • Base Bonus: Upon the first purchase, Solar Chant provides a permanent 10% boost to your overall faith generation rate.
  • Transcendence Scaling: Once you unlock the Transcendence upgrade (which requires 125,000 Worship, 7,500 Faith, and 7,500 Gold), Solar Chant becomes a tiered upgrade.
  • Incremental Growth: For every additional level of Solar Chant purchased using Transcendence, the faith production bonus increases by an additional +10%.

Strategic Utility

  • Late-Game “Priest Strategy”: As players enter the late game and find themselves waiting for slow-moving resources like Unobtainium or Eludium, a common strategy is to reassign the majority of the kitten workforce to the Priest job. Solar Chant is critical here, as multiple levels of the upgrade significantly amplify the output of these [Priests] ( /job/priest/).
  • Faith Reset Loops: High levels of Solar Chant facilitate a positive feedback loop. By dramatically increasing faith production, players can more rapidly rebuild their Solar Revolution production bonus (which caps at 1000%) after performing a faith reset or “Adoring the Galaxy”.
  • Transcendence Progression: Accelerating faith production via Solar Chant is essential for reaching the extremely high epiphany requirements of later Transcendence Tiers, such as Tier 15, which requires approximately 3.04 million percent epiphany.

item.title: Templars
item.description:
Templars is a high-tier religious upgrade available under the Order of the Sun in the Religion tab. It specifically enhances the utility of Temples by increasing the colony’s maximum Catpower capacity.

Acquisition and Costs

To unlock the Templars upgrade, you must first research Theology and accumulate a significant amount of religious capital.

  • Prerequisites: You must have at least 75,000 Worship accumulated through “Praising the Sun”.
  • Cost: The initial upgrade costs 3,500 Faith and 3,000 Gold.
  • Price Ratio: Like most religious upgrades, it has a price ratio of 2.5, meaning subsequent levels (if unlocked via Transcendence) become significantly more expensive.

Effects and Scaling

The primary function of Templars is to turn your Temples into storage facilities for Catpower.

  • Transcendence Scaling: If you have purchased Transcendence, you can buy additional levels of the Templars upgrade. Each additional level increases the bonus by a further +25 max catpower per Temple.

Strategic Utility

While it may seem like a minor bonus early on, Templars is a critical component for late-game industrial and trade optimization:

  • Blueprint Farming: In the endgame, players often rely on Mints to generate the massive quantities of blueprints needed for high-tier structures. Because Mints scale their output based on your maximum Catpower capacity, the boost provided by Templars directly increases your blueprint production speed.
  • Policy Synergies: The Liberalism policy is specifically noted for allowing players to acquire more levels of the Templars upgrade more easily, which in turn assists with ivory generation and international trade.
  • Resource Management: By significantly raising the Catpower cap, Templars allows you to store enough energy to fund massive space missions, such as Orbital Launches (which require 5,000 Catpower) or Rorschach Missions (which require 80,000 Catpower), without being limited by standard housing caps.

item.content:encoded:
Transcendence is a permanent religious progression system in the sources that allows players to stack tiered upgrades and boosts the efficiency of “Adoring the stars”. It is unlocked in the religion tab for 7,500 Faith and 7,500 Gold once you have reached a prerequisite of 125,000 Worship.

Mechanics of Transcending

Once the initial upgrade is purchased, a permanent “Transcend” button appears. This allows you to spend Epiphany—a hidden resource converted from Worship when you “Adore the Galaxy”—to increase your Transcendence Tier.

  • Carry Over: Transcendence tiers are among the few things that permanently carry over through game resets.
  • Tier Thresholds: The cost in Epiphany increases exponentially; for example, Tier 1 requires ~1.97% Epiphany, while Tier 15 requires ~3.04M%.

Key Benefits of Increasing Tiers

  • Epiphany Multiplier: Each Transcendence Tier increases the amount of Epiphany you receive when you “Adore the Galaxy”. The conversion multiplier is (TT+1)^2 (e.g., at Tier 10, your conversion is 121x stronger).
  • Cryptotheology Unlocks: Specific tiers are required to purchase advanced endgame buildings using Relics:
    • Tier 1: Black Obelisk (increases Solar Revolution cap).
    • Tier 7: Event Horizon (increases global resource storage).
    • Tier 15: Blazar (massively boosts Time Crystal and Relic production).
    • Tier 25: Holy Genocide (unlocks the Post-Apocalypse challenge).
  • Multi-Level Upgrades: Researching the Transcendence upgrade allows you to purchase religious abilities like Solar Chant, Scholasticism, and Golden Spire multiple times, with each level further boosting faith production and storage.
  • Atheism Challenge: In the Atheism challenge, your Solar Revolution cap is increased by +100% per Transcendence Tier.

Progression and Costs

Increasing your Transcendence Tier requires a set amount of Epiphany. The cost escalates exponentially, with Tier 1 requiring only ~1.97% Epiphany bonus, while Tier 15 requires over 3.04 million%.

Transcendence Tier Minimum Epiphany Bonus Needed Milestones & Unlocks
Tier 1 ~1.97% Black Obelisk
Tier 3 ~17.38% Black Nexus
Tier 12 ~8.26M% Black Radiance
Tier 15 ~3.04M% Blazar (Endgame Goal)
Tier 20 ~451.14M% Dark Nova
Tier 25 ~66.96G% Holy Genocide/Post-Apocalypse

Strategic Progression: BMF and TAP

The sources provide two specific methods for managing Transcendence to avoid losing progress or production bonuses:

  1. The BMF Reset Protocol: To maximize prestige gains before a game reset, players should follow the Backup, Metas, Faith (BMF) order. Within the Faith step, you must Transcend before you Adore the stars. Because higher Transcendence tiers increase the conversion multiplier for Adoration, this order ensures you receive the maximum possible Epiphany for your next run.
  2. The Mid-Run TAP Method: If you wish to Transcend without resetting the entire game, the sources suggest the TAP (Transcend, Adore, Praise) procedure. A rule of thumb is to have at least 1.5 times the Epiphany threshold listed for the next tier before doing this, otherwise, you may severely decrease your praising bonus and harm your current production.

Endgame Benefits and Unlocks

Reaching higher Transcendence tiers is essential for late-game and “Phase 3” progression:

  • Cryptotheology: Tiers are required to unlock specific endgame buildings. For instance, Black Obelisks require Tier 1, while Blazars—which are vital for time crystal and relic production—require Tier 15.
  • Atheism Challenge: Completing this challenge grants a permanent reward where the Solar Revolution cap increases by 100 percentage points for every Transcendence tier you possess.
  • Tiered Upgrades: Each tier allows you to purchase additional levels of religious upgrades like Solar Chant (+10% faith generation), Scholasticism (+ science), and Sun Altar (+ happiness/faith storage).
  • Unicorn Tears Challenge: In this mode, Unicorn Tombs increase your maximum faith specifically based on your Transcendence Tier.

Pro-Tip: Strategists recommend waiting until you have 1.5x to 2x the required Epiphany bonus for the next tier before Transcending mid-run to avoid a significant temporary drop in your Solar Revolution production bonus.
